decision_problem: Choose among competing alerting configurations with trade-offs across speed, resilience, and inclusion.
root_non_achievedness: What are the materially distinct admissible transformation paths for the regional emergency alerting system, what unresolved distinctions separate those paths, and what missing facts block commitment?

candidate_paths.title: Example A: speed-first configuration
candidate_paths.summary: Optimizes fast warning delivery, accepting weaker resilience and inclusion guarantees.

candidate_paths.title: Example D: balanced configuration
candidate_paths.summary: Balances speed, resilience, and inclusion without maximizing any single dimension.

dominant_distinctions.title: Optimization target
dominant_distinctions.description: The core distinction is whether the system is optimized for speed alone or for a balance across speed, resilience, and inclusion.

ambiguities: The examples describe competing configurations rather than a state-transition graph.
missing_information: The acceptable minimum for inclusion guarantees is not stated.
